session.description: overnight: the US day market (Blue Ocean ATS, 20:00-04:00 New York time before the trading day it belongs to), served apart from the other sessions (ADR 0030).

reason.description: fixture_missing: a synthetic fixture has no bar; not_available_as_of_cutoff: published after the cutoff; provider_no_bar: the provider reported no bar (normally no trades in that minute on the feed); outside_entitlement: the plan does not allow this range yet (e.g. the latest 15 minutes of SIP on a free plan); not_yet_final: too recent for an absent bar to be treated as no trades. session_not_covered: the source does not provide this session (e.g. a broker feed confirmed for regular hours only). beyond_source_history: older than this source can serve (e.g. a broker returning only the latest 40 bars).

currency.description: USD for US listings, KRW for Korean (kr:) listings.
USD for US listings, KRW for Korean (kr:) listings.

asserted_at_utc.description: When the server recorded the user's assertion.

selected_interval_start_utc.description: Candle the user clicked: context only, never the execution time.

executed_at_utc.description: User-claimed execution time; null only when time_precision is unknown. Independent of the selected interval.

currency.description: USD for US listings, KRW for Korean (kr:) listings.

fee_assumption.description: Total fees for the round trip.

slippage_assumption.description: Adverse price slippage per share, applied at entry and at exit.

account_ref.description: Broker ledger only: the broker account this FIFO book belongs to. Accounts are never netted against each other.

fees_unreported_count.description: Executions without reported fees (Kiwoom): realized P&L and fees leave their fees out. Absent when every fee is known.

settlement_fee_lines.description: Broker ledger: settlement lines whose commission and tax are included in fees and realized P&L (Kiwoom US). Absent when none.

ImportedExecution.description: A fill read from a user-supplied broker statement file. Not API-verified.

currency.description: USD for US listings, KRW for Korean (kr:) listings.

CredentialSummary.description: A registered provider key as shown to the user. Secret values and full account numbers are never part of this contract.

environment.description: Whether a broker key belongs to a real (실전) or a demo (모의투자) account; null for vendor keys, which are not per account.

active.description: The key's provider is the running market-data provider.

SessionListResponse.description: Consecutive trading sessions ending at end_date (inclusive), oldest first.

FilingSplitsResponse.description: Splits of a US listing: the provider's (Alpaca corporate actions), and splits the dilution analyzer read from SEC filings by rules, not compared with another source (ADR 0046). Evidence only: no price depends on it, and a difference does not say which side is wrong.

status.description: not_checked: the analyzer never read this issuer. none_found: its filings named none, which is no guarantee. Before filings_from nothing was read.

compared_with.description: Null when the provider's splits could not be read.

events.description: Every split either side names, oldest first: same (both), not_compared (the analyzer did not read that period), or one of the differences. Unconfirmed readings that match nothing are left out.

SymbolSearchResponse.description: US-listed stocks matching a ticker or company-name query, from the provider's symbol directory. Any result can be charted with the active provider.

fetched_at_utc.description: When the directory was last fetched from the provider.

stale.description: The directory is older than a day and could not be refreshed; results may miss new listings.

local_name.description: Korean display name from Toss, when a Toss key is registered and Toss has one.

former_symbol.description: ADR 0033: the result is the listing this old ticker was renamed to.

status.description: ADR 0033: a delisted instrument seen in trades; its chart ends where exchange trading ended.

last_trade_date.description: Delisted: the latest trade date seen for it (the chart's natural date).

moved_to.description: Delisted: the ticker it trades under now (often an OTC ticker), if it was renamed.

MarketQuote.description: A point-in-time quote read on demand from a broker: last price, order book, recent trades and daily price limits. Not stored; prices are exact decimal strings and times UTC.

observed_at_utc.description: When this API read the quote.

StockInfo.description: A broker's reference data for one stock and its active buying warnings, read on demand.

ExchangeRate.description: A broker's reference (display) exchange rate for one minute-long window; actual trades may use a different rate.

BrokerMarketCalendar.description: A broker's market hours for the previous, current and next business day, compared with the local exchange calendar where one exists. Closed sessions are absent.

agrees.description: Whether the local calendar the charts use has the same bounds; null when there is no local session to compare.

ResearchTable.description: A broker research table for reading (rankings, market indicators, sectors, Korean trading trends). Values are exact strings as the broker sent them, times are UTC, nested fields are dotted column names. Not an input to charts, indicators or backtests.

key.description: The symbol or sector ID the table is about, if any.

next_cursor.description: Value to pass as `until` or `before` for older rows.

StockRankingsResponse.description: ADR 0049: one Toss stock ranking read on demand (trading amount or volume, gainers, losers, or Korean investors' net buying or selling). Values are exact decimal strings as Toss sent them; each row carries the listing the symbol directory knows for it, so it can be opened on a chart. Not stored and not chart data.

ranking.description: TOSS_SECURITIES_* count Toss Securities fills only; the others the whole market. NET_* are Korean investors' net buying or selling (KRX and NXT together).

duration.description: Trading days ranked over; null for investor rankings (latest business day only).

exclude_caution.description: Investment-caution stocks were left out (Toss excludeInvestmentCaution).

ranked_at_utc.description: When Toss computed the ranking; null when it has none for this choice.

base_price.description: Gainers and losers: the price at the start of the duration; other rankings: the previous close.

change_rate.description: Decimal ratio (0.0125 = 1.25%) of last_price over base_price.

net_amount.description: NET_BUY / NET_SELL: net amount bought or sold in KRW, always positive.

listing.description: The symbol directory's listing, to open on a chart; null when the symbol is not in a known list.

fees.description: null when the broker's order history does not report it (Kiwoom, Meritz); never assumed zero.

commission.description: null when the broker's order history does not report it (Kiwoom, Meritz); never assumed zero.

tax.description: null when the broker's order history does not report it (Kiwoom, Meritz); never assumed zero.

currency.description: USD for US listings, KRW for Korean (kr:) listings.

time_meaning.description: reported_last_fill: the broker's filledAt for the order, when its last fill happened (Toss). reported_fill_time: the one fill time the broker reports for the order, without saying whether it is the first or the last fill (Kiwoom cntr_time, Meritz cntg_ymdh). Neither is a per-fill time. not_reported: the broker reports no fill time (Kiwoom domestic settlement lines); executed_at_utc is null and trade_date gives the day.

granularity.description: order_aggregate: one record per order, total filled quantity at the average fill price. settlement_line: one line of the broker's transaction history (Kiwoom domestic), without an order number.

ordered_at_utc.description: Null when the broker reports no order time (settlement lines).

instrument_resolution.description: ADR 0033: renamed - the trade is on the chart of the ticker the company uses now (symbol keeps the ticker the broker reported); delisted - the company has left US exchanges and its chart ends there. Absent for a plain listing.

trade_date.description: The trade (contract) date in the exchange's calendar, when no fill time is reported.

BrokerOrderExecution.description: An order's execution as reported by a broker API, read on demand and stored append-only. A separate ledger from manual entries and statement imports; never summed with them.

execution_count.description: All executions in the ledger (or for the instrument); `executions` may list only the newest of them.

time_unresolved.description: Kiwoom and Meritz: orders whose reported time could not be placed on a US session (04:00-20:00 New York, or the day market before it). Not stored.

conflicts.description: Broker order IDs whose reported execution changed after it was stored; the stored record is kept.

unknown_symbols.description: Symbols skipped as unknown_instrument, with their order counts (most first, at most 1,000).

BrokerSyncResult.description: What one on-demand sync of closed broker orders stored.

errors.description: Parts of this account that could not be read; the rest is shown.

BrokerAccountSnapshot.description: A broker account view read on demand: holdings, buying power, commission rates and open orders. Account numbers appear only as their last four digits. Nothing here is stored.

BrokerSellableQuantity.description: How much of one stock a broker account can sell now, read on demand.

RealtimeEvent.description: One event relayed from the broker's realtime stream to the app. Trade and order book frames can be dropped by the broker (no sequence numbers); order events are lossless only within one connection.

oneOf.description: A trade print received from the stream.
A change to one of the user's own orders.
The broker ledger was resynced after an order closed or the stream reconnected.
The relay's connection to the broker.

TickListResponse.description: Trade ticks this app received from a broker stream for one symbol and New York date. Lossy by nature: a received record, never a complete tape, and never an input to bars.

count.description: All stored ticks for the day; `ticks` may hold only the latest of them.

bar_count.description: Bar-count mode: the first N bars from start_date, read forward up to end_date (any past window, not only up to today). Absent: every bar from start_date to end_date.

anchored.description: true: every in-sample stretch starts at the first bar and grows; false (default): rolling windows of in_sample_bars.

walk_forward.description: Walk-forward (ADR 0032): rolling in-sample/out-of-sample windows in bars; each window's grid combination with the best in-sample objective trades its out-of-sample stretch.

expire_bars.description: Bars the order waited for its price before expiring.

bar_count_requested.description: Bar-count mode: the number of bars asked for; bar_count is how many were found.

custom_indicators.description: Python indicator versions used by rules operands (ADR 0023), each pinned by its code SHA-256.

walk_forward.description: Present on walk-forward runs: the windows, the parameters chosen in-sample and their in-sample score. Everything else in the results is out-of-sample only.

ReconciliationLink.description: A pairing with a record of another ledger. Differences compare the counterpart group (summed quantity, quantity-weighted average price) with the broker order.

price_difference_bps.description: Counterpart average price against the broker average price, in basis points.

ReconciliationRecord.description: One record of an actual-fill ledger as the reconciliation classified it. The ledger record itself is unchanged.

time_utc.description: Execution time; for a broker order, its reported last fill (or the order time when none was reported). Null when a manual record's time is unknown.

TradeReconciliationResponse.description: A computed, read-only comparison of the broker API ledger with the manual and statement-import ledgers. Nothing is merged, rewritten or stored.

view.description: Derived on request from the ledgers; never stored.

since_utc.description: Filters the records shown; earlier records still count as counterparts.

until_utc.description: Exclusive end of the records shown; later records still count as counterparts.

from_date.description: First exchange-local day shown (inclusive), on each record's own exchange calendar.

status_filter.description: Narrows `records` (and `record_count`) only; `summary` and `breakdown` count every status.

ledger_counts.description: Records in each ledger before any filter, so a view can tell an empty manual/import ledger from a filtered one.

breakdown.description: Status counts of every record in range (before the status filter), per instrument and per exchange-local day; a record without a time counts under date null.

record_count.description: All records; `records` may list only the newest of them, while `summary` always counts all.

BrokerFeeLine.description: Commission and tax of one settlement line (Kiwoom US ust21100), which carries no order number. Positions add these per account and instrument; orders keep fees null.

max_order_amount_usd.description: Per-order cap in US dollars (ADR 0047); present only when set.

PaperOrderLimits.description: Limits of one paper-trading approval (ADR 0037). null means no limit for now.

final_by.description: source: the data source finalized the signal bar; settle: the plan's settle time after its end had passed

PaperOrderIntent.description: One strategy signal turned into a paper order before anything is sent (ADR 0037). Append-only; its outcome is stored separately.

PaperOrderSubmission.description: One attempt to send a paper order to a broker's demo domain (ADR 0037).

PaperExecution.description: A fill simulated by a broker's paper-trading server. Never a market fill and never summed with real ledgers (ADR 0037).

PaperRunnerStatus.description: Kill-switch and arming state of the paper-order runner (ADR 0037).

fx_source.description: fixed: `fx` confirmed at approval; bok_ecos: the runner reads the Bank of Korea ECOS USD/KRW rate each day

unfilled_cancel_seconds.description: Seconds an accepted order may stay unfilled before the runner cancels it. Absent: left to the user.

confirm_seconds.description: Live plans only (ADR 0047): seconds the user has to confirm each order before it expires.

bar_settle_seconds.description: Seconds after a bar's end after which the runner treats it as final for signals; null: the source's finality only

protection.description: Protective exits of the approved strategy (ADR 0044); only when it has any.

PaperApproval.description: One user approval of a paper-trading plan; its ID is the SHA-256 of its content (ADR 0037).

PaperIntentListResponse.description: Recent paper-order intents with their outcome and submission (ADR 0037).

LiveConfirmationListResponse.description: Live orders waiting for the user's confirmation or just confirmed (ADR 0047).

PaperExecutionListResponse.description: Simulated paper fills; never real executions (ADR 0037).

watched.description: The running plan is the strategy that opened this protection.

PaperPositionListResponse.description: Paper holdings with their protective state; warns about what nothing protects (ADR 0044).

BrokerConditionList.description: ADR 0048: the Kiwoom US conditions SIW is connected to, as saved in 영웅문Global when read. They are made and edited there; `seq` is Kiwoom's number at that moment and changes when a condition is added above it.

fetched_at_utc.description: When this API received the reply.

missing.description: Connected condition names that are not saved in 영웅문Global now.

BrokerConditionResult.description: ADR 0048: one run of a saved Kiwoom US condition. A point-in-time read like a quote: not stored, not bars, not evidence, and never used by replay, backtests or agents.

fetched_at_utc.description: When this API received the reply.

condition.description: `seq` is Kiwoom's number at the time of the run, looked up by name.

complete.description: False when the page limit was reached with more rows left.

kiwoom_exchange.description: Kiwoom's stex_tp (ND, NY, NA). Not a venue: NY also covers NYSE Arca.

listing.description: The app's own listing for the ticker; null when the lookup does not know it (not chartable).

last.description: Kiwoom's 현재가, as reported; the time it refers to is not documented.

change.description: Kiwoom's 전일대비, signed, as reported; the time it refers to is not documented.

change_percent.description: Kiwoom's 등락률, percent, as reported; the time it refers to is not documented.

volume.description: Kiwoom's 누적거래량, as reported; the time it refers to is not documented.

open.description: Kiwoom's 시가, as reported; the time it refers to is not documented.

high.description: Kiwoom's 고가, as reported; the time it refers to is not documented.

low.description: Kiwoom's 저가, as reported; the time it refers to is not documented.

ScreeningCandidates.description: ADR 0052 S1: a US session's screening candidates — symbols the realtime condition record (ADR 0051) listed or added before the cutoff, plus symbols the user added — with the latest result of each check. ADR 0055 (U0) adds the record's gaps, how each entry time is known, and how often a symbol entered and how long it stayed. Not an order, not a plan approval.

cutoff_utc.description: Only events SIW received before this time count.

selection_noon_utc.description: 12:00 New York time of the session date: selection mostly ends by then (ADR 0054).

recorded.description: False when there is no condition record at all.

gaps.description: Stretches of the window before the cutoff that no watch covered (pauses over 5 s). A symbol could enter or leave there unseen; this is not a quiet market.

previous_end.description: Why the watch before the gap ended (renewed, stopped, interrupted, unclosed, an error).

watch_coverage.description: How much of the session window the record covers, so a gap is not read as a quiet list.

first_seen_utc.description: When SIW first received it in this session (condition), or when the user added it.

in_list.description: In the condition's list when the last watch before the cutoff last heard; null for manual-only.

listing.description: The app's own listing for the ticker; null when the lookup does not know it (not chartable).

first_seen_how.description: enter_event: an enter event, so first_seen_utc is the entry time as SIW received it. The list values: first seen in a watch's opening list, so it entered at an unknown time after entered_after_utc. manual: added by the user.

entered_after_utc.description: Earliest time the entry could have happened when it is not known; null otherwise.

enter_count.description: Enter events before the cutoff (opening lists not counted). Many in a short time is a symbol flickering at the condition's threshold.

seconds_in_list.description: Time in the condition's list within covered stretches before the cutoff.

ScreeningCheck.description: ADR 0052: one stored check of one candidate. `result` depends on `check`; for `entry` it holds the last closed daily bar, the bars used and every simple condition with the values it compared. Stored results are only added, never changed.

after_the_fact.description: Run after the session ended: stored data, not what was live at the cutoff.

status.description: passed/failed: check A. material/no_material: check B. ok/incomplete: checks C, D and the off-exchange structure (ADR 0053); pending: C, D and the structure while their input is still being read. The rest: any check. The momentum check (ADR 0055): ok, incomplete (minutes may still arrive), no_data, error.

ScreeningOffExchangeResult.description: ADR 0052 §5 (S2): `result` of an `off_exchange` screening check. Off-exchange (TRF-reported, Alpaca SIP exchange code D) volume by price over the latest sessions known at the cutoff, shown as '장외 체결(TRF 보고)', never 'dark pool': ATS and broker internalization are mixed, direction is unknown, and timestamps are report times. Closed sessions come from the structure model's session cache (ADR 0053, shared); the open session is read live up to the cutoff.

data_until_utc.description: min(cutoff, created_at - publication delay): no later trade is read.

sessions_requested.description: Closed sessions asked for (default 20, the structure model's window). The session still open at the cutoff comes on top.

source.description: live: the session open at the cutoff, read in this request. cache: a closed session from screening_structure.sqlite3 (read once, whole).

read_at_utc.description: When the trades were read. More than an hour after data_until_utc: reconstructed after the cutoff.

partial.description: True when the data ends inside the session's 04:00-20:00 ET window.

truncated.description: The newest session, read back from the cutoff, hit the fetch limit: range_utc starts at the earliest trade read (to the second). Older sessions read in part are dropped, not truncated.

off_market_price_volume.description: Off-exchange volume whose condition (derivatively priced, average price, prior reference, contingent, ...) keeps it out of the price levels.

late_report_volume.description: Off-exchange volume reported late or out of sequence (L, Z, U).

removed_trades.description: Trades marked canceled or incorrect by Alpaca's `u` field.

sessions.description: Fully read closed sessions and the open session (partial, maybe truncated), newest first.

progress.description: Closed sessions: cached so far, still being read in the background (status pending), and missing with the reader's reason.

reference_time_utc.description: Last trade at a market price (any venue) before data_until_utc, as Alpaca sent it (nanoseconds).

side.description: Where the bin sits against reference_price. A candidate support/resistance zone, never a forecast.

finra_weekly_ats.description: FINRA weekly ATS facts from the Dark Pool Agent (ADR 0024), context only: never used for the levels.

pages.description: Pages of the open session read in this request.

max_pages.description: Page limit for the open session.

live_max_seconds.description: Time for reading the open session.

max_seconds.description: The whole trade budget: the open session, then waiting for the closed sessions.

ScreeningOffExchangeStructureResult.description: ADR 0053: `result` of an `off_exchange_structure` screening check, shown as '장외 체결 가격 구조'. The dark-pool stress model v2 (darkpool-stress/2.0.0) moved onto Alpaca SIP trades: price zones and gaps of off-exchange plus lit volume over the latest closed sessions. A stage (LOW~EXTREME) and scores appear only for a forecast ISSUED under a parameter set the registry approved; research scores never appear here. Not a price forecast or an order.

data_until_utc.description: min(cutoff, created_at - publication delay): the decision time; no later trade is used.

then.description: Not issued: no stage, no scores, no expected responses on the card.

ScreeningMomentumResult.description: ADR 0055 (U0): the market before a symbol entered the condition list, from the data provider's 1m bars that had closed by first_seen_utc (rebuilt when the check ran). A label on the candidate, not a filter; the condition itself ran on Kiwoom's prices.

ScreeningFlowWatch.description: ADR 0057 §3 (U-a): every candidate's stage 3 realtime flow state at the newest closed 1m bar, rebuilt from bars on each request (not stored). `result` holds the state (eligible, excluded, warming_up, unknown, halted), the liquidity and volatility windows with each minute, the state changes through the session, the halt spans used and the rules. States only: excluded blocks new buys and keeps resting orders; nothing here places or cancels an order.

after_the_fact.description: Judged after the session ended: final bars, not what was live.

status.description: incomplete: a window holds a minute the account cannot see yet. stage2_excluded: excluded for the day at stage 2; not watched.

ScreeningStage2.description: Stage 2 material impact (ADR 0057 §2, U-b) from the latest news check's conclusions. Inference (rules plus the news service's LLM reading), not verified fact; not a trade instruction.

outcome.description: excluded_today: a low-impact material; the day's trading leaves the symbol out (stage 3 does not watch it).
